messages:
Mei: heads up — we need to finalize offer IDs + metering dimensions across AWS/GCP/Azure for the SaaS listing. Can people drop the current mapping here?
Priya: on it. need the SKU mapping so sales quoting doesn't break.
Sam: legal here — reminder: different marketplaces have different T&Cs (esp Azure). I'll surface any required contract clauses.
Carlos: product question: what are the trial/seat semantics we want the marketplace to enforce vs. our backend? e.g., 30-day trial, auto-convert.
Jordan: engineering: we need the SaaS Proxy endpoint, entitlements schema, and a canonical offer_id field. also whether marketplace sends a license token or we pull via API.
marketplace-bot: New AWS sandbox offer created: offer_id ama-311c0 (sandbox). Console: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/marketplace-console/
Mei: great — can someone paste the mapping snippet? I have a sheet but want canonical JSON to land in the repo.
Priya: minimal mapping we need (example):
```json
{
  "aws": {"offer_id": "ama-xxxx", "metering_dimension": "RedwoodSeats", "region": "us-east-1"},
  "gcp": {"listing_id": "gcp-xxxx", "billing_metric": "redwood_seats", "private_offer_id": "po-123"},
  "azure": {"publisher_id": "redwood-inc", "sku": "redwood-saas-basic", "offer_plan_id": "plan-basic"}
}
```
Sam: legal note: Azure requires a Publisher Agreement and adds a publisher indemnity clause in some regions — do not promise refunds until finance/legal sign off. Also GCP private offers require a contract id from sales. I'll flag any redlines.
Carlos: also product: confirm whether marketplace seat changes should be event-driven (webhook) or polling. my preference: webhook with idempotency keys.
Mei: agreed. @Jordan can you add sample webhook + example payload to the integrations doc? We'll need schema for seat delta events.
Jordan: sample payload (will add to repo under infra/marketplace/integrations):
```
POST /entitlements/webhook HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "customer_id": "cust-12345",
  "offer_id": "ama-311c0",
  "seats": 10,
  "delta": 2,
  "event": "seats_updated",
  "trial": true,
  "idempotency_key": "evt-9f8b"
}
```
Jordan: also note: AWS meter reports come via their metering API; we need finance to create metering dimension RedWoodSeats and give us the ARN.
Priya: timeline: internal beta (partners + sales) next Wednesday, public listing ~2 weeks after legal signs off and finance validates metering.
Sam: I'll try to get legal redlines by EOD tomorrow.
Mei: perfect — I'll update the Google sheet with these fields and ping finance for the metering ARN + GCP contract id. tagging this as action items: add JSON mapping to repo, add webhook sample, legal redlines, finance metering. :thumbsup:
